mn101:0.1: suttantapiṭake majjhimanikāyo uparipaṇṇāsako namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa
mn101:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati devadahaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo.
mn101:2.4: santi bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ vādino evaṃ
mn101:2.5: diṭṭhino: ‘yaṅkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetu.
mn101:2.6: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantībhāvā navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo
mn101:2.7: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
mn101:3.1: evaṃ vādāhaṃ bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhe upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi:
mn101:3.2: saccaṃ kira tumhe āvuso nigaṇṭhā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn101:3.3: ‘yaṅkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetu.
mn101:3.4: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantībhāvā navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo
mn101:3.5: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
mn101:3.6: te ce me bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā evaṃ puṭṭhā āmāti paṭijānanti:
mn101:4.5: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso nigaṇṭhā, jānātha:
mn101:4.6: akaramheva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ na nākaramhā’ti.
mn101:4.8: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso nigaṇṭhā, jānātha
mn101:4.11: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso nigaṇṭhā, jānātha:
mn101:4.12: ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ, ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjīretabbaṃ ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
mn101:4.14: kiṃ pana tumhe āvuso nigaṇṭhā, jānātha:
mn101:4.15: diṭṭheva dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampada’nti.
mn101:5.1: iti kira tumhe āvuso nigaṇṭhā, na jānātha:
mn101:5.2: ‘ahuvamheva mayaṃ pubbe na nāhuvamhā’ti. na jānātha
mn101:5.3: ‘akaramheva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ na nākaramhā’ti. na jānātha,
mn101:5.4: ‘evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ kammaṃ akaramhā’ti. na jānātha
mn101:5.5: ‘ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ, ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjīretabbaṃ, ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti. na jānātha:
mn101:5.6: diṭṭheva dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ.
mn101:5.7: evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ na kallamassa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:5.8: “yaṅkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ pubbe katahetu.
mn101:5.9: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantībhāvā navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo
mn101:5.10: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī”ti.
mn101:6.2: ahuvamheva mayaṃ pubbe na nāhuvamhā’ti. jāneyyātha
mn101:6.3: akaramheva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ na nākaramhā’ti. jāneyyātha
mn101:6.4: ‘evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ kammaṃ akaramhā’ti, jāneyyātha
mn101:6.5: ‘ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjīretabbaṃ, ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti. jāneyyātha
mn101:6.6: ‘diṭṭheva dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ,
mn101:6.7: evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ kallamassa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:6.8: “yaṅkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetu.
mn101:6.9: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantībhāvā navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo
mn101:6.10: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī”ti.
mn101:7.1: seyyathāpi āvuso nigaṇṭhā, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷhūpalepanena,
mn101:7.2: so sallassapi vedanāhetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya.
mn101:7.3: tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
mn101:7.4: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto setthana vaṇamukhaṃ parikanteyya.
mn101:7.5: so setthanapi vaṇamukhassa parikantanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya.
mn101:7.6: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto esaniyā sallaṃ eseyya.
mn101:7.7: so esaniyāpi sallassa esanā hetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya.
mn101:7.8: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto sallaṃ abbaheyya.
mn101:7.9: so sallassapi abbahanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya.
mn101:7.10: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto agadaṅgāraṃ vaṇamukhe odaheyya.
mn101:7.11: so agadaṅgārassapi vaṇamukhe odahanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya.
mn101:7.12: so aparena samayena rūḷhena vaṇena sañchavinā arogo assa sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṅgamo.
mn101:7.14: ‘ahaṃ kho pubbe sallena viddho ahosiṃ savisena gāḷhūpalepanena.
mn101:7.15: so’haṃ sallassapi vedanāhetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ.
mn101:7.16: tassa me mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpesuṃ.
mn101:7.17: tassa me so bhisakko sallakatto satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikanti.
mn101:7.18: so’haṃ satthenapi vaṇamukhassa parikantanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ.
mn101:7.19: tassa me so bhisakko sallakatto esaniyā sallaṃ esi.
mn101:7.20: so’haṃ esaniyāpi sallassa esanāhetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ.
mn101:7.21: tassa me so bhisakko sallakatto sallaṃ abbahi
mn101:7.22: so’haṃ sallassāpi abbahanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ
mn101:7.23: tassa me so bhisakko sallakatto agadaṅgāraṃ vaṇamukhe odahi.
mn101:7.24: so’haṃ agadaṅgārassapi vaṇamukhe odahanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ.
mn101:7.25: so’mhi etarahi rūḷhena vaṇena sañchavinā arogo sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṅgamo’ti.
mn101:8.1: evameva kho āvuso nigaṇṭhā, sace tumhe jāneyyātha
mn101:8.2: ahuvamheva mayaṃ pubbe, na nāhuvamhā’ti. jāneyyātha
mn101:8.3: ‘akaramheva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ, na nākaramhā’ti. jāneyyātha
mn101:8.4: evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ kammaṃ akaramhā’ti. jāneyyātha
mn101:8.5: ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ, ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjīretabbaṃ. ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti. jāneyyātha
mn101:8.6: ‘diṭṭheva dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ.
mn101:8.7: evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ kallamassa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:8.8: yaṅkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetu:
mn101:8.9: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantībhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo
mn101:8.10: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
mn101:9.1: yasmā ca kho tumhe āvuso nigaṇṭhā, na jānātha
mn101:9.2: ‘ahuvamheva mayaṃ pubbe na nāhuvamhā’ti. na jānātha
mn101:9.3: ‘akaramheva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ, na nākaramhāti. na jānātha
mn101:9.4: ‘evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ kammaṃ akaramhā’ti. na jānātha
mn101:9.5: ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjīretabbaṃ, ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti. na jānātha
mn101:9.6: diṭṭheva dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ.
mn101:9.7: tasmā āyasmantānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ na kallamassa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:9.8: ‘yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetu.
mn101:9.9: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantībhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo.
mn101:9.10: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn101:10.1: evaṃ vutte bhikkhave, te nigaṇṭhā maṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn101:10.2: ‘nigaṇṭho āvuso, nātaputto sabbaññū sabbadassāvī, aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti:
mn101:10.3: ‘carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhita’nti.
mn101:10.5: ‘atthi kho vo āvuso nigaṇṭhā, pubbeva pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ, taṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakārikāya nijjīretha.
mn101:10.6: yampanettha etarahi kāyena saṃvutā vācāya saṃvutā manasā saṃvutā, taṃ āyatiṃ pāpassa kammassa akaraṇaṃ,
mn101:10.7: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantībhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo
mn101:10.8: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
mn101:10.9: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca, tena camhā attamanā’ti.
mn101:11.1: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhikkhave, te nigaṇṭhe etadavocaṃ:
mn101:11.2: ‘pañca kho ime āvuso nigaṇṭhā, dhammā diṭṭhevadhamme dvidhā vipākā.
mn101:11.4: saddhā ruci anussavo ākāraparivitakko diṭṭhi nijjhānakkhanti.
mn101:11.5: ime kho āvuso nigaṇṭhā, pañca dhammā diṭṭheva dhamme dvidhā vipākā.
mn101:11.6: tatrāyasmantānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ kā atītaṃse satthari saddhā, kā ruci, ko anussavo, ko ākāraparivitakko, kā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantī’ti.
mn101:11.7: evaṃvādī kho ahaṃ bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhesu na kañci sahadhammikaṃ vādapaṭihāraṃ samanupassāmi.
mn101:12.1: puna caparāhaṃ bhikkhave, te nigaṇṭhe evaṃ vadāmi :
mn101:12.3: yasmiṃ hi vo samaye tibbo upakkamo hoti tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyetha.
mn101:12.4: yasmiṃ pana vo samaye na tibbo upakkamo hoti na tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, na tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyethā’ti.
mn101:12.5: yasmiṃ no āvuso gotama, samaye tibbo upakkamo hoti tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyāma.
mn101:12.6: yasmiṃ pana no samaye na tibbo upakkamo hoti, na tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, na tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyāmā’ti.
mn101:13.1: iti kirāvuso nigaṇṭhā, yasmiṃ vo samaye tibbo upakkamo hoti tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyetha.
mn101:13.2: yasmiṃ pana vo samaye na tibbo upakkamo hoti. na tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, na tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyetha.
mn101:13.3: evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ na kallamassa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:13.4: ‘yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ pubbe katahetu.
mn101:13.5: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantībhāvā navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo
mn101:13.6: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
mn101:14.1: sace āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yasmiṃ vo samaye tibbo upakkamo hoti tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, na tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyetha.
mn101:14.2: yasmiṃ pana vo samaye na tibbo upakkamo hoti na tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyetha.
mn101:14.3: evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ kallamassa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:14.4: ‘yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetu.
mn101:15.1: yasmā ca kho āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yasmiṃ vo samaye tibbo upakkamo hoti tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyetha.
mn101:15.2: yasmiṃ pana vo samaye na tibbo upakkamo hoti na tibbaṃ padhānaṃ, na tibbā tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyetha.
mn101:15.3: te tumhe sāmaññeva opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyamānā avijjā aññāṇā sammohā vipaccetha:
mn101:15.4: ‘yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetu.
mn101:15.5: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā byantībhāvā navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo.
mn101:15.6: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti.
mn101:15.7: evaṃ vādīpi kho ahaṃ bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhesu na kiñci sahadhammikaṃ vādapaṭihāraṃ samanupassāmi.
mn101:16.1: puna caparāhaṃ bhikkhave, te nigaṇṭhe evaṃ vadāmi :
mn101:16.2: ‘taṃ kiṃ maññathāvuso nigaṇṭhā, ‘yamidaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā samparāyavedanīyaṃ hotū’ti labbhameta’nti’
mn101:16.4: yaṃ panidaṃ kammaṃ samparāyavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbhameta’nti.
mn101:17.1: taṃ kiṃ maññathāvuso nigaṇṭhā, yamidaṃ kammaṃ sukhavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā dukkhavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbhameta’nti.
mn101:17.3: yaṃ panidaṃ kammaṃ dukkhavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā sukhavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbhameta’nti.
mn101:18.1: taṃ kiṃ maññathāvuso nigaṇṭhā, yamidaṃ kammaṃ paripakkavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā aparipakkavedanīyaṃ hotū’ti labbhameta’nti.
mn101:18.3: yaṃ panidaṃ kammaṃ aparipakkavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā paripakkavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbhameta’nti.
mn101:19.1: taṃ kiṃ maññathāvuso nigaṇṭhā, yamidaṃ kammaṃ bahuvedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā ‘appavedanīyaṃ hotū’ti labbhameta’nti.
mn101:19.3: yaṃ panidaṃ kammaṃ appavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā ‘bahuvedanīyaṃ hotū’ti labbhameta’nti.
mn101:20.1: taṃ kiṃ maññathāvuso nigaṇṭhā, yamidaṃ kammaṃ vedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā ‘avedanīyaṃ hotū’ti labbhameta’nti.
mn101:20.3: yaṃ panidaṃ kammaṃ avedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā vedanīyaṃ hotū’ti labbhameta’nti.
mn101:21.1: iti kirāvuso nigaṇṭhā, yamidaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā ‘samparāyavedanīyaṃ hotū’ti alabbhametaṃ. yamidaṃ kammaṃ samparāyavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā ‘diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hotū’ti alabbhametaṃ. yamidaṃ kammaṃ sukhavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā ‘dukkhavedanīyaṃ hotū’ti alabbhametaṃ. yamidaṃ kammaṃ dukkhavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā sukhavedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbhametaṃ. yamidaṃ kammaṃ paripakkavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā ‘aparipakkavedanīyaṃ hotū’ti alabbhametaṃ, yamidaṃ kammaṃ aparipakkavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā ‘paripakkavedanīyaṃ hotū’ti alabbhametaṃ. yamidaṃ kammaṃ bahuvedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā appavedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbhametaṃ. yamidaṃ kammaṃ appavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā bahuvedanīyaṃ hotū’ti alabbhametaṃ. yamidaṃ kammaṃ vedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā avedanīyaṃ hotū’ti alabbhametaṃ. yamidaṃ kammaṃ avedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā vedanīyaṃ hotū’ti alabbhametaṃ.
mn101:21.2: evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ aphalo upakkamo hoti aphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:22.2: evaṃvādīnaṃ bhikkhave nigaṇṭhānaṃ dasa sahadhammikā vādānuvādā gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchanti.
mn101:22.3: sace bhikkhave sattā pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:22.4: addhā bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā pubbe dukkatakammakārino, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn101:22.5: sace bhikkhave, sattā issaranimmāṇahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:22.6: addhā bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā pāpakena issarena nimmitā, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn101:22.7: sace bhikkhave, sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:22.8: addhā bhikkhave nigaṇṭhā pāpasaṅgatikā, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn101:22.9: sace bhikkhave, sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:22.10: addhā bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā pāpābhijātikā, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn101:22.11: sace bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhadhammūpakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,

mn101:22.25: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, aphalo upakkamo hoti aphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:23.1: kathañca bhikkhave saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:23.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu na heva anaddhabhūtaṃ attānaṃ dukkhena addhabhāveti dhammikañca sukhaṃ na pariccajati. tasmiñca sukhe anadhimucchito hoti.
mn101:23.4: imassa kho me dukkhanidānassa saṅkhāraṃ padahato saṅkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti. imassa pana me dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekkhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hotīti.
mn101:23.5: so yassa hi khvāssa dukkhanidānassa saṅkhāraṃ padahato saṅkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti. saṅkhāraṃ tattha padahati.
mn101:23.6: yassa panassa dukkhanidānassa ajjhu pekkhato upekkhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hoti. upekkhaṃ tattha bhāveti.
mn101:23.7: tassa tassa dukkhanidānassa saṅkhāraṃ padahato saṅkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti.
mn101:23.9: tassa tassa dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekkhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hoti.
mn101:24.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso itthiyā sāratto paṭibaddhacitto tibbacchando tibbāpekkho.
mn101:24.2: so taṃ itthiṃ passeyya aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ.
mn101:24.4: api nu tassa purisassa amuṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
mn101:24.7: asu hi bhante, puriso amussā itthiyā sāratto paṭibaddhacitto tibbacchendā tibbāpekkho.
mn101:24.8: tasmā taṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
mn101:25.1: atha kho bhikkhave, tassa purisassa evamassa:
mn101:25.2: ahaṃ kho amussā itthiyā sāratto paṭibaddhacitto tibbacchando tibbāpekkho.
mn101:25.3: tassa me amuṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā.
mn101:25.4: yannūnāhaṃ yo me amussā itthiyā chandarāgo taṃ pajaheyya’nti.
mn101:25.5: so yo amussā itthiyā chandarāgo taṃ pajaheyya,
mn101:25.6: so taṃ itthiṃ passeyya aparena samayena aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ.
mn101:25.8: api nu tassa purisassa amuṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
mn101:25.11: asu hi bhante, puriso amussā itthiyā vītarāgo,
mn101:25.12: tasmā taṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ na uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
mn101:26.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu na heva anaddhabhūtaṃ attānaṃ dukkhena addhabhāveti, dhammikañca sukhaṃ na pariccajati, tasmiñca sukhe anadhimucchito hoti.
mn101:26.3: ‘imassa kho me dukkhanidānassa saṅkhāraṃ padahato saṅkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti. imassa pana me dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekkhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hotī’ti.
mn101:26.4: so yassa khvāssa dukkhanidānassa saṅkhāraṃ padahato saṅkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti. saṅkhāraṃ tattha padahati.
mn101:26.5: yassa panassa dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekkhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hoti. upekkhaṃ tattha bhāveti.
mn101:26.6: tassa tassa dukkhanidānassa saṅkhāraṃ padahato saṅkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti.
mn101:26.8: tassa tassa dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekkhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hoti.
mn101:26.10: evampi bhikkhave saphalo upakkamo hoti, saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:27.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati: ‘
mn101:27.2: yathāsukhaṃ kho me viharato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti.
mn101:27.3: dukkhāya pana me attānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti. kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.
mn101:27.6: tassa dukkhāya attānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti. kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.
mn101:27.7: so na aparena samayena dukkhāya attānaṃ padahati.
mn101:27.9: yassa hi so bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthāya dukkhāya attānaṃ padaheyya svāssa attho abhinipphanno hoti.
mn101:27.10: tasmā na aparena samayena dukkhāya attānaṃ padahati.
mn101:28.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, usukāro tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpeti paritāpeti ujuṃ karoti kammaniyaṃ.
mn101:29.1: yato kho bhikkhave, usukārassa tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpitaṃ hoti paritāpitaṃ hoti ujuṃ kataṃ hoti kammaniyaṃ. na so taṃ aparena samayena usukāro tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpeti paritāpeti ujuṃ karoti kammaniyaṃ.
mn101:29.3: yassa hi so bhikkhave, atthāya usukāro tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpeyya paritāpeyya ujuṃ kareyya kammaniyaṃ. svāssa attho abhinipphanno hoti.
mn101:29.4: tasmā na aparena samayena usukāro tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpeti paritāpeti ujuṃ karoti kammaniyaṃ.
mn101:29.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati :
mn101:29.6: ‘yathāsukhaṃ kho me viharato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti.
mn101:29.7: dukkhāya pana me attānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.
mn101:29.10: tassa dukkhāya attānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.
mn101:29.11: so na aparena samayena dukkhāya attānaṃ padahati.
mn101:29.13: yassa hi so bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthāya dukkhāya attānaṃ padaheyya. svāssa attho abhinipphanno hoti.
mn101:29.14: tasmā na aparena samayena dukkhāya attānaṃ padahati.
mn101:29.15: evampi bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:30.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idha tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
mn101:30.2: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
mn101:30.3: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
mn101:31.1: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto.
mn101:31.2: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
mn101:31.3: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn101:31.5: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
mn101:31.6: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya’nti.
mn101:31.7: so aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
mn101:32.1: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
mn101:32.2: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati.
mn101:32.3: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
mn101:32.4: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
mn101:32.5: pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya, iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn101:32.6: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn101:32.7: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
mn101:33.1: so santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati
mn101:33.2: seyyathāpi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti sapattabhārova ḍeti.
mn101:33.3: evameva bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamati samādāyeva pakkamati.
mn101:33.4: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn101:34.1: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī,
mn101:34.2: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn101:34.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn101:34.8: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ. tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn101:34.9: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
mn101:35.1: so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti. sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti. saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti. asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti. uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti. gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
mn101:36.1: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato imāya ca ariyāya santuṭṭhiyā samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato
mn101:36.2: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ paḷālapuñjaṃ.
mn101:36.3: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn101:37.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati. abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn101:37.2: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn101:37.3: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn101:37.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati. ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn101:37.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu, vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn101:38.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn101:38.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn101:38.3: evampi bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:39.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā, ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn101:39.2: evampi bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:40.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti. yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn101:40.2: evampi bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:41.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn101:41.2: evampi bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:42.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn101:42.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattāḷīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi, anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe, amutrāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto so tato cuto idhūpapannoti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbe nivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn101:42.3: evampi bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:43.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite aneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn101:43.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti: ‘ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā. te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā’ti. iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn101:43.3: evampi bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:44.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn101:44.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn101:44.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn101:45.1: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
mn101:45.3: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
mn101:45.4: evampi kho bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti, saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:46.2: evaṃvādiṃ bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ dasa sahadhammikā pāsaṃsaṭṭhānā āgacchanti:
mn101:46.3: sace bhikkhave, sattā pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti.
mn101:46.4: addhā bhikkhave tathāgato pubbe sukatakammakārī, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā anāsavā sukhā vedanā vedeti.
mn101:46.5: sace bhikkhave, sattā issaranimmāṇahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti.
mn101:46.6: addhā bhikkhave, tathāgato bhaddakena issarena nimmito, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā anāsavā sukhā vedanā vedeti.
mn101:46.7: sace bhikkhave, sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:46.8: addhā bhikkhave, tathāgato kalyāṇasaṅgatiko, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā anāsavā sukhā vedanā vedeti.
mn101:46.9: sace bhikkhave, sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:46.10: addhā bhikkhave, tathāgato kalyāṇābhijātiko, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā anāsavā sukhā vedanā vedeti.
mn101:46.11: sace bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhadhammūpakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:46.12: addhā bhikkhave, tathāgato kalyāṇadiṭṭhadhammūpakkamo, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā anāsavā sukhā vedanā vedeti.
mn101:46.13: sace bhikkhave, sattā pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.14: no ce sattā pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.15: sace bhikkhave, sattā issaranimmāṇahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.16: no ce sattā issaranimmāṇahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.17: sace bhikkhave, sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.18: no ce sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.19: sace bhikkhave, sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.20: no ce sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.21: sace bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhadhammūpakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.22: no ce sattā diṭṭhadhammūpakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, pāsaṃso tathāgato.
mn101:46.24: evaṃvādiṃ bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ ime dasa sahadhammikā pāsaṃsaṭṭhānā āgacchantīti.
mn101:46.26: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
